title: sambucus cerulea f. glauca
intro: Sambucus cerulea f. glauca, commonly known as the Blue Elderberry, is a shrub or small tree that belongs to the Adoxaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating colds, flu, and other respiratory issues, due to its potential health benefits, such as reducing inflammation and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Blue Elderberry are attributed to its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Blue Elderberry include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
